basic_info.description: Fast-Track Condo Conversion Possible! Located on the iconic palm-lined Dolores Street, this light-filled home offers incredible outlooks, private outdoor space, and a sprawling floor plan, all at the apex of Noe/Mission/Bernal. Renovated in '23, this sizable home boasts the latest fixtures, finishes, and amenities. Set in a 2-unit building, the residence captures eastern morning light and western sunsets over Twin Peaks, and dappled light throughout the day. The oversized LR offers multiple entertaining areas, a wood-burning FP, and opens to a sunset-facing terrace. An adjacent DR also opens to the terrace, while the updated kitchen with Fisher & Paykel appliances and an eat-at breakfast bar, overlooks mature fruit trees. The west-facing primary features 2 large closets and en-suite bath, while the east-facing BR overlooks the mature landscaped backyard, a space perfect for BBQs and play. The second bath features a sizable bathtub. Add'l features: private 2-car tandem garage w/ 220V, in-unit laundry, an intercom camera security gate, and a separate street entrance. Walk to Noe's 24th Street for local shops and dining, as well as nearby green spaces. Just a block from the J line, tech shuttles, and with easy freeway access: a sunny oasis in the heart of it all!
